name: The Medicare Advantage denial lawsuits
blurb: The class actions over nH Predict and similar tools used to cut off post-acute and rehabilitation care for Medicare Advantage members, now on this site's tracker.

points.desc: Filed November 2023 in the District of Minnesota, alleging UnitedHealth and naviHealth used the nH Predict algorithm to deny post-acute care against physician recommendations; contract and implied covenant claims proceeded past a motion to dismiss in 2025.
points.name: Estate of Lokken v. UnitedHealth

points.desc: Filed December 2023 in the Western District of Kentucky, alleging Humana used the same nH Predict tool to deny rehabilitation care to Medicare Advantage members.
points.name: Barrows v. Humana

points.desc: The HHS Office of Inspector General found in April 2022 that 13 percent of prior authorization requests Medicare Advantage plans denied met Medicare coverage rules.
points.name: The finding behind the cases

summary: The class actions over nH Predict and similar tools used to cut off post-acute and rehabilitation care for Medicare Advantage members, now on this site's tracker.
